title: Choir and Cellar
author: W. M. Eastwick
blurb: Edmund Voss, an urban explorer mapping tunnels that aren't on any survey, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the last resident signs the papers.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
